description: This file is an HTML page implementing a web-based database visualizer interface with embedded CSS styles and JavaScript logic for fetching and displaying databases, tables, and data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list and resets interface states.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles the display of tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the data into an HTML table.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual table cell based on data type and size.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses content within a cell to show full data.
